parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in assays against the human mitochondrial glutaminase kidney isoform (CHEMBL2146302) where the assay organism is Homo sapiens. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays, then to target_dictionary, and join compound_structures as an inner join. Filter by target ChEMBL ID and assay organism. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
